items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Flo Bernard used to stop and talk to him all the time.

ctx.x: Flo Bernard used to stop and talk to him all the time. Spargo was doing, Spargo got into a lot of other things besides, Spargo played up there yet, but he got into some other things too, I don't know what he was doing, something else, but you know. But Edwards didn't do it, but he didn't sell papers and go in there.
Yeah, well Larry was up there then too. Larry was up there.
